description: This Java class 'Tenants' provides helper methods for creating Tenant objects with associated TrustedCertificateAuthority entities, primarily for testing purposes within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: Tenants
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for creating Tenant instances with associated TrustedCertificateAuthority objects for testing purposes.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (X509Certificate)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object using an X509Certificate by extracting its subject and public key.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (X500Principal, PublicKey)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object using a distinguished name and a public key.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (String, byte[], String)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object with specified subject DN, public key bytes, and algorithm, defaulting validity to now plus one year.

methods.name: createTenantForTrustAnchor (String, byte[], String, Instant, Instant)
methods.description: Creates a Tenant object with specified subject DN, public key bytes, algorithm, and validity period between notBefore and notAfter.
